final: SELECT trader_type, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM (SELECT trader_type, avg_optvolrt, deviation, deviation - type_avg_deviation AS excess FROM (SELECT trader_type, avg_optvolrt, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS type_avg_deviation FROM (SELECT trader_type, avg_optvolrt, avg_optvolrt - baseline AS deviation FROM (SELECT transref, tradekind AS trader_type, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(AVG(optvolrt)) OVER () AS baseline FROM sentimentandfundamentals JOIN transactionrecord ON sentimentandfundamentals.transref = transactionrecord.transreg JOIN trader ON transactionrecord.trdref = trader.tradereg GROUP BY transref, tradekind)) WHERE trader_type IS NOT NULL) WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation) GROUP BY trader_type
